role: two-valued logical equivalence over arbitrary atoms
notes: Same value under every valuation P to {0,1}; companion of the registered consequence relation \(\models_P\) (written \(\entails_P\)); reduces to source equivalence when P is Prop.

role: injection of a finite atom set into Prop
notes: Domain a finite subset A of P; initial when a bijection onto p_0 to p_{k-1}. Sans-serif letter chosen to avoid the registered P2 uses of iota (base type, description binder, at-least-n sentence).

Structural recursion: atoms of A to their r-images, other atoms to bottom, commutes with every constructor. Chosen instead of a sharp superscript, which is registered for the P2 incidence translation.
w^r: P to {0,1} reads w on r-star of each atom; v_r: Prop to {T,F} is true exactly on r-images of atoms true under v.
